ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:3 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous patches on the distal 30% of both the left and right lobes. The left lobe exhibits a large white patch with dense dark mottling. The right lobe shows a more solid white region toward the tip. The central and proximal regions are predominantly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 70-degree V-shaped depression at the central intersection, though the vertex is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge. High-frequency, low-amplitude peaks characterize the inner lobes, while the outer distal edges exhibit lower-frequency, higher-amplitude notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending outward from the median notch with an upward recurve at the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular clusters visible on the far-left and far-right lobe tips. Extensive dark circular mottling concentrated within the distal white regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 4-5 distinct, parallel diagonal linear disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe, crossing from the white distal region into the dark medial region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the left lobe surface; irregular deep notches on the trailing edges of both lobes consistent with physical trauma.
